reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific nanoscale surface-segregation-driven premelting mechanism for FeNiCrCoCu HEA nanoparticles that is not reported or suggested in any of the provided passages. While P42 discusses surface energy differences driving a disorder-to-order transition in MPEI nanoparticles, it does not link surface energy to elemental segregation, local melting point depression, or premelting. The hypothesis combines the general concept of surface energy differences with a new mechanistic pathway (segregation of lower-melting elements to the surface, local melting point reduction, and coalescence of premelt regions) to explain the thermal response of a specific HEA system, which goes beyond the existing literature.
